item.title: 10 Spring-Inspired Scones
item.description: As the days grow longer and new blooms begin to bud, the beauty of spring is hard to ignore. Whether you prefer fruity, floral, or even delightfully savory bites, these delectable scones will pair wonderfully with your favorite tea blend for a springtime menu that is sure to please a variety of palates.

item.title: Ode to the Irish
item.description: Photography by John O’Hagan • Styling by Maghan Armstrong • Food Styling by Kathleen Kanen • Recipe Development by Janet Lambert A lovely table adorned in green and white sets a picture-perfect scene to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day on March 17 amongst shamrocks and inspired cuisine, like Grasshopper Mini Tartlets and Irish Apple Cakes.

item.title: 11 Festive Recipes for St. Patrick's Day
item.description: From tasty treats that are inspired by classic Irish fare to creative twists on beloved favorites, this selection of scones, savories, and sweets features plenty of options to delight tea guests at a festive St. Patrick’s Day tea.

item.title: <i>TeaTime</i> March/April 2026 Issue Preview
item.description: In our new March/April 2026 issue of TeaTime, welcome exuberant spring with inspiring tea menus and beautiful tablescapes that celebrate St. Patrick’s Day, Easter, and the splendor of a secret garden. item.title: Tea Amongst the Shamrocks
item.description: Photography by Marcy Black Simpson Recipe Development/Food Styling by Jade Sinacori From the verdant centerpieces to the cheery china, a table adorned in green, white, and gold is an idyllic way to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day on March 17, especially when the tea fare is inspired by Irish cuisine.

item.title: 10 Scrumptious Cakes for Spring
item.description: Dazzle your teatime guests by serving beautiful and scrumptious cakes to conclude your afternoon tea gathering. This collection features refreshing flavors and eye-catching garnishes that are sure to brighten your spring tea table and satisfy your sweet tooth all season long.

item.title: Treasured Teapot: Blushing Irish Beauty
item.description: Text by Britt Crawford • Photography by William Dickey Softly tinted details on the Irish-crafted Neptune Pink teapot by Belleek Pottery gently highlight a unique and memorable teatime accoutrement. item.title: Easter Festivity Tea
item.description: Photography by Mac Jamieson Recipe Development by Laura Crandall/Jon Jacobson/Taylor Franklin Wann and Food Styling by Megan Lankford Invite friends and loved ones for an extravagant Easter celebration at a table bedecked for the occasion. From Carrot Cake Scones to Easter Egg Macarons, each course of this tea party incorporates classic trademarks of the holiday.

item.title: 11 Cheery Treats for a Children's Easter Tea
item.description: Easter is right around the corner, so we have compiled an array of our favorite recipes that children will delight in.

item.description: Text and Photography by Bruce Richardson Spring is an exciting time to visit tea gardens worldwide as hillside fields burst into vibrant shades of emerald green.
